title.zh: 适用边界：并非所有Metal都倒梯形
title.en: Scope: not all metal sections are inverted trapezoids

subtitle.zh: 先明确上宽下窄，还是上窄下宽
subtitle.en: First distinguish a wider top from a wider bottom

body.zh: • 材料本身不决定唯一 Profile
body.en: • Material alone does not define a unique profile

body.zh: 形貌是否正常，必须结合材料、路线与目标Profile判断
body.en: Judge profile by material, route and target
A possible target for typical Cu damascene

body.zh: 不同材料 ×不同路线×不同目标，Profile可能不同；不存在任何一种绝对先进的形貌
body.en: Materials × routes × targets yield different profiles; no one shape is universally more advanced
Mistaking via funnel for metal taper

body.zh: 把负锥度当正常填充设计
body.en: Treating negative taper as normal fill design

body.zh: 下游影响：决定异常归因于介质刻蚀、金属刻蚀、薄膜覆盖还是填充
body.en: Downstream: assign the cause to dielectric etch, metal etch, film coverage or fill

body.zh: 边界：若“倒梯形”指上窄下宽，它属于Negative Taper/ Re-entrant，需要单独检查。
body.en: Scope: if inverted trapezoid means a wider bottom, it is negative taper / re-entrant and needs separate review
